_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Kɛnɛ wɛr umaynut {player_id} ɣ Tic Tac Toe.
Tawala nnek maɣiwɛr ad tɛɣzɛzɛtɛɣ tasga tis kraḍ (ɛzɛlma, sɛɛda, neɣ tɛɣzi) ɣ takarḍa.
Asɛmɛl nnek, kɛnɛ wɛr ad tɛɣzɛzɛtɛɣ tasga n takarḍa (0-8) iɣɛr ad tɛɣɛɣ tamazɣa nnek ɣɛn.
Alaɣ, '[4]' ad tɛɣɛɣ tamazɣa nnek ɣ tasga tɛɣzi n takarḍa.
Asɛmɛl nnek umaynut {player_id}, kɛnɛ wɛr '{symbol}', maɣiwɛr umaynut nniḍen '{opponent_symbol}'.
